errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of tasks within a taxonomy for deep reasoning in speech, audio, music, and their mix. The chart is divided into ten slices
errors.evidence: The chart is a two-level sunburst chart, not a simple pie chart. It is composed of 4 main categories in an inner ring and 16 subcategories in an outer ring, not a total of ten slices.

errors.text_span: representing categories including Professional Knowledge & Reasoning, Spatial Analysis, Temporal Analysis, Correlation Analysis, Music Theory, Counting & Statistics, Environmental Perception & Reasoning, Speaker Analysis, Emotion & Perception, and Content Analysis
errors.evidence: This list incorrectly identifies a subset of subcategories from the chart's outer ring as the main categories. The primary categories are in the inner ring: Perception Layer, Semantic Layer, Cultural Layer, and Signal Layer. The list also omits several subcategories.
The label on the chart is "Emotion & Intention", not "Emotion & Perception".
The percentage 4.3% corresponds to the "Signal Layer" in the inner ring, not the "Acoustic Quality Analysis" subcategory.

errors.text_span: A legend is present to the upper left of the chart, labeling each category with its corresponding color.
errors.evidence: There is no legend on the chart. All labels are placed directly on or adjacent to the chart segments.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from larger to smaller proportions
errors.evidence: The main slices are not ordered by size. The clockwise order of percentages for the inner ring categories is 41.2%, 40.4%, 4.3%, and 14.1%, which is not a descending order.

The description omits mentioning the primary categories from the inner ring: Perception Layer (40.4%) and Signal Layer (4.3%). It only mentions Cultural Layer and Semantic Layer when quoting percentages.
